must_reject_if: action_id is missing or is not one of the three exact actions
Core cannot bind explicit authorization and ControlLease to the account, target and action
Core cannot bind a new operation ref and idempotency key to the action
required current-page composition, field, media, commit-control or identity fact is absent, stale or mismatched
a previous related operation is running or unknown without completed reconciliation
post-check or reconciliation refs cannot be produced
the action would expose credentials, media bytes, user content or private runtime material
action_id is missing, unknown, or does not match requested_path
Core cannot bind one single-action authorization decision to the exact action and target
Core cannot bind one TaskTurnRecord idempotency key to the exact action and target
required Harbor page/control/identity fact is absent, stale, or mismatched
operation result or external effect is unknown and a success claim is requested
post-check or reconciliation ref is absent
an undeclared action, retry, replay or bypass is requested
the action would store media bytes, user content, or private runtime material

consumer_boundary: Lode declares the proposed actions and remains non-executing. Core owns authorization, ControlLease, idempotency, ExternalOutcome and reconciliation; Harbor owns live execution/evidence; App renders refs-only state.
source_decisions: #295 is one package with page-proven save_draft, publish and marker-bound cleanup actions.
WebEnvoy #419/#422/#423 supply formal live consumer evidence and cleanup.
Core remains the only owner of authorization, ControlLease, idempotency, ExternalOutcome and reconciliation.
non_goals: No browser execution or independent live admission from this static guardrail.
No generic commit framework, retry, bypass or copied Core lifecycle.
